Employment change by industry, from the BLS Current Employment Statistics survey

No data published for this period Flagged as an anomaly for that industry

Tile area is the absolute change in employees in both colour modes — sizing by percent would let a very small industry outweigh Food Services. Colour is symmetric around zero, so a loss and a gain of equal size read at equal intensity. CES publishes only some children for many parents, so the tiles at a level are not a complete partition of it — every tile is the value CES actually reports, never scaled or padded to make the pieces add up. Three roll-ups that would double-count their own same-level components — Health care, Specialty trade contractors and Motor vehicles and parts — are hidden for that reason; append &dupes=1 to show them.
